follow-up time: Until discharge from the recovery room
exposure: Spinal anesthesia with 10.75 to 11 mg of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine and 0.15 to 0.2 mg morphine
cohort: 161 healthy term pregnant women at 38 to 42 weeks of gestational age scheduled for elective cesarean section
finding: Spinal anesthesia may affect huff cough strength in parturients undergoing elective cesarean section, as evidenced by decreased PEFR even at discharge from the recovery room.
